'''Apatros''' was the only colony on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Apatros/Legends|of the same name]]. The colony was controlled by the [[Outer Rim Oreworks Company]], which mined [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] on the planet, and was used to house [[Miner/Legends|miners]]. The colony only contained two unique buildings&mdash;the [[Outer Rim Oreworks Market|ORO Market]] and [[Groshik's cantina]]. Apatros was the home of a miner named [[Darth Bane/Legends|Dessel]], who would eventually become the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Bane.

==Description==
The colony of Apatros was the only settlement on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planet of [[Apatros/Legends|Apatros]], and was governed by the [[Outer Rim Oreworks Company]]. Apatros was mostly a ramshackle town of temporary [[Barracks/Legends|barracks]] made of [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] put together by Outer Rim Oreworks to house the several hundred [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] [[Miner/Legends|miners]] who worked on the planet. Among the [[Mining/Legends|miners]], Apatros was commonly referred to as "the [[muck-huts]]". The domiciles themselves were in poor condition, as the [[Window/Legends|windows]], doors, and roofs were perpetually broken and a layer of dust covered the floors. Also, entire families were often forced to live in a single room. The colony and the cortosis mines were connected by a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] that went back and forth between the two locations.<ref name="PoD" />

Apatros was less than a [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] on each square side, making it possible to walk from any given building to any other structure in less than twenty [[Galactic Standard Calendar|standard minutes]]. Although all the buildings in Apatros were identical, navigating the streets was easy, as the barracks were placed in straight rows and columns. This formed a grid of streets between the uniformly spaced buildings. The streets were cleaned just enough by Outer Rim Oreworks to keep conditions sanitary, but were always cluttered with junk. Apatros only had two buildings that were dissimilar to the other structures&mdash;a [[Outer Rim Oreworks Market|market]], and [[Groshik's cantina]], which lay a few hundred meters beyond the edge of the town.<ref name="PoD" />

==History==
Apatros was established by Outer Rim Oreworks to house the cortosis miners who worked on the planet. In the year [[1003 BBY]], a resident of Apatros and cortosis miner named [[Darth Bane/Legends|Dessel]] got in a fight in the Apatros streets with three crew members of a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]] over a game of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]], killing one of them. With the help of a [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] bartender named [[Groshik]], Dessel was able to escape arrest and join the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Army/Legends|army]] in the [[New Sith Wars]] against the Republic. After serving with distinction, his [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]] was discovered, and he eventually became Darth Bane, one of the most important and influential [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lords of the Sith]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Timeline of galactic history/Legends|history]].<ref name="PoD" />

==Inhabitants==
Apatros was mostly inhabited by miners working in the cortosis mines, the majority of which were [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. However, other [[Species/Legends|species]] lived in the colony, including a Neimoidian named Groshik, who owned a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] there. The most famous of Apatros' inhabitants was Dessel, who worked in the cortosis mines for years before leaving Apatros and becoming a Dark Lord of the Sith.<ref name="PoD" />

==Locations==
Apatros only had two distinct buildings: the general store and Groshik's cantina. The general store, once a barracks, was controlled by Outer Rim Oreworks and sold basic items to miners at high prices. Groshik's cantina was the main hangout of off-duty miners, and was located several hundred meters from the colony. It was operated by the Neimoidian bartender Groshik, and also contained an Outer Rim Oreworks-controlled [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] room.<ref name="PoD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Apatros colony made its first appearance in [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s [[2006]] novel, ''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]'',<ref name="PoD" /> the first volume of the [[Star Wars: Darth Bane Trilogy|''Darth Bane Trilogy'']].<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref>
